help:
Usage: note [OPTIONS] {text}

  Save a quick note to memory, tagged #kind:note.

  Examples: st note "Check the deploy after merge" | st note "..." --tags
  "#widget:claude-code"

Arguments:
  text  Note text  [required]

Options:
  --topic <str>         Episode topic header  [default: Note]
  -s, --summary <str>   Override summary (10-40 chars)
  --tags <str>          Extra comma-separated tags
  --scope <str>         Memory scope  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>      Scope id (for project scope)
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: save a scoped note in Agent Hub memory
